facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 与 KRAY 坐在蘑菇状总部气泡外的长椅上谈接头安排。
facts.anchor: They were sitting on a bench out by the mushroom-like Headquarters Bubble.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 听到 London 后表示惊讶，说他不知道英国也安插了 NOC。
facts.anchor: “London,” said BUTTONFLY, sounding surprised. “I didn’t know we were putting NOCs in the U.K.”

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 说伦敦那边的接头人是 LIFTSHITS。
BUTTONFLY 说安全是一条连续谱，这些会面都只做一次。
facts.anchor: Security exists on a continuum. These will be one-shot meetings.

facts.fact: 苏黎世一线要找日内瓦的 Lucky M. VANDERROHE。
facts.anchor: For Zurich, you’ll need to see Lucky M. VANDERROHE from Geneva

facts.fact: 米兰一线要见 STUCCO（Tamara L.），地点在 Biffi Scala，BUTTONFLY 还提醒小心俄罗斯妓女和美人计。
facts.anchor: “Milan,” he said appreciatively. “Stay at the Principe di Savoia. Watch out for the Russian hookers there, too, we don’t need you falling into somebody’s honey trap. Meet STUCCO, Tamara L., at Biffi Scala.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 从绿色皮面通讯录里抄下一串电话号码交给 KRAY。
facts.anchor: BUTTONFLY transcribed a list of numbers from a green leather address book.

facts.fact: 各接头人不会知道 KRAY 的名字，只认「Howard 的朋友」这个说法。
facts.anchor: They won’t know your name, just say you’re a friend of Howard.
